caption: The drawing depicts a long, double-caped overcoat in a light yellowish-beige color. The coat features wide, layered capes over the shoulders and upper arms, with three distinct layers visible. The collar is a contrasting reddish-brown color, and there is a small area of green fabric visible inside the neck opening. The cuffs of the coat are folded back, revealing a red interior lining, and the coat is fastened in the front with a series of buttons. On the right-hand side of the image, there are two sketched views in faint outline, both depicting the back of the coat, with one sketch showing the detailing of the back and the other indicating the placement of seams and features such as buttons or fasteners at the waist and cape layers. The overall composition is centered around the colored front view of the coat, with the two back sketches arranged side-by-side to the right. The background is a plain, off-white color. In the lower right corner, there is a signature or notation written in small text.
title: Man's Great Coat
